notes:
- New: Workspace save/open - save a chart's symbol, timeframe, strategy and parameters, indicators, paintbars and drawings to a named .rnw file and reopen it later; unsaved-changes prompt protects against losing work
- New: pick exactly which parameters to optimize in Optimize This Instrument - leave a parameter unchecked to hold it fixed at an editable value, check it to sweep a Start/Stop/Increment range
- New: optimize Risk Management (Stoploss %/Target %/Trailing Stop %/Breakeven Trigger %/Time Exit) alongside a strategy's own parameters
- New: live progress during Optimize This Instrument - elapsed time, estimated remaining, and the best combination found so far
- New: copy or export optimization results - select rows and copy (Ctrl+C or right-click) into Excel, or export the full table to CSV
- Fixed: Performance Report dollar figures (Total Net Profit, equity curve $ view, Trade Log) now correctly include Slippage and Commission - previously computed from raw price movement only; Trade Log shows Gross and After Cost side by side
- New: Settings & Symbol shows the trading costs actually in effect, per-side and round-trip
- Fixed: a newly created strategy wasn't appearing in the Chart tab's dropdown until restart
- Small polish: .rnw files show the app's own icon in Explorer; Performance Report tooltips rebuilt for reliable readability across Windows theme configurations
